resolution: Both halves of req_0444 done. (1) 'Wire it up' (5f7a6d491): batch commitMany so a 352-piece move/clone/delete is one snapshot not a per-piece freeze; Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y undo for buildings folded into the workspace timeline. (2) Heightfield awareness — USER RULED 'sit on a flat pad' — built as a shared, pure, idempotent helper GAME_BUILD.placed.liftToTerrain that lifts each stamped building (stampId group) as one level pad so its lowest piece sits on the terrain height under its footprint centre (paint a hill, it rides up, never warps). Applied at EVERY consumption site so editor and game never drift: build pane (IsoAuthor render+hit-test+ghost lift; edits keep raw y so move/clone re-lift with no double-lift; clone mints a fresh stampId), compile (packageMap.createHmscMapfile lifts once feeding both baked geometry AND colliders), and F2 walk-mode (render+occluders+colliders lift). Idempotent + read-only (stored y never changes). Loose single pieces keep authored y. Commits ce4fb8090 (helper+iso+compile) and 475db573a (F2); all bundle clean.
